items.question: What is the average net order value in 2026 so far?

    AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY o.id, o.shipping_fee
)

items.question: What net revenue was attributed to each campaign for orders in 2026, by campaign name?

items.question: What was net revenue by region last calendar quarter vs the one before?
items.sql:
WITH q3_rev AS (
    SELECT r.id AS region_id,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount + o.shipping_fee) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY r.id
),
refund_q3 AS (
    SELECT r.id AS region_id,
           SUM(rf.amount) AS refund_amt
    FROM orders o
    JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id = o.id
    JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY r.id
),
net_q3 AS (
    SELECT r.id AS region_id,
           COALESCE(q.revenue,0) - COALESCE(f.refund_amt,0) AS net_rev_q3
    FROM regions r
    LEFT JOIN q3_rev q ON q.region_id = r.id
    LEFT JOIN refund_q3 f ON f.region_id = r.id
),
q2_rev AS (
    SELECT r.id AS region_id,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount + o.shipping_fee) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY r.id
),
refund_q2 AS (
    SELECT r.id AS region_id,
           SUM(rf.amount) AS refund_amt
    FROM orders o
    JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id = o.id
    JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY r.id
),
net_q2 AS (
    SELECT r.id AS region_id,
           COALESCE(q.revenue,0) - COALESCE(f.refund_amt,0) AS net_rev_q2
    FROM regions r
    LEFT JOIN q2_rev q ON q.region_id = r.id
    LEFT JOIN refund_q2 f ON f.region_id = r.id
)
SELECT r.code AS region_code,
       r.name AS region_name,
       ROUND(n3.net_rev_q3, 2) AS net_revenue_last_quarter,
       ROUND(n2.net_rev_q2, 2) AS net_revenue_prior_quarter,
       ROUND(n3.net_rev_q3 - n2.net_rev_q2, 2) AS revenue_difference,
       CASE WHEN n2.net_rev_q2 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((n3.net_rev_q3 - n2.net_rev_q2) / n2.net_rev_q2, 4)
       END AS pct_change
FROM regions r
JOIN net_q3 n3 ON n3.region_id = r.id
JOIN net_q2 n2 ON n2.region_id = r.id
ORDER BY r.code;

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT o.region_id, o.ordered_at
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
)
SELECT
    f.region_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 END) AS orders_q2,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END) AS orders_q3,
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END)
     - COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 END)) AS diff_orders,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 END) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END)
                  - COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 END))
                 ::numeric / COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND f.ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 END)

items.question: Of the customers whose first order was in January 2025, how many ordered again within 90 days of that first order?
items.sql:
WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           MIN(o.ordered_at) AS first_order_dt
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING MIN(o.ordered_at) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
       AND MIN(o.ordered_at) < DATE '2025-02-01'
),
repeat_within_90 AS (
    SELECT f.customer_id
    FROM first_orders f
    JOIN orders o
      ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id
     AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
     AND o.ordered_at > f.first_order_dt
     AND o.ordered_at <= f.first_order_dt + INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY f.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_repeat_within_90d
FROM repeat_within_90;

items.question: Among products with at least 100 units sold in 2025, which one had the highest refund rate?
items.sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) * oi.quantity * fr.usd_per_unit) AS sales_usd,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN fx_rates fr ON fr.currency_code = o.currency_code AND fr.rate_date = o.ordered_at::date
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        SUM(r.amount * fr.usd_per_unit) AS refund_usd
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
    JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
    JOIN fx_rates fr ON fr.currency_code = o.currency_code AND fr.rate_date = r.refunded_at::date
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.refund_usd, 0) / NULLIF(s.sales_usd, 0), 4) AS refund_rate
FROM products p
JOIN sales s ON p.id = s.product_id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON p.id = r.product_id
WHERE s.units_sold >= 100
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
